input: Search the web for "summer childcare" and school-age summer care for kids and teens in Madison, Yancey, Mitchell and McDowell counties, NC (Marshall, Mars Hill, Burnsville, Marion). Use that wording in your searches, not just "camp", and list every organization you find.
searches: YMCA Western North Carolina McDowell summer day camp 2025

candidates.name: YMCA of Western North Carolina
candidates.note: Discovery Camp at Pleasant Gardens Elementary served rising first graders through age 12, June 15–August 14, 2026; childcare subsidy vouchers accepted.

candidates.name: Madison County Community Learning Centers
candidates.note: Woodson Branch Nature School offered K–8 summer camps in June–July 2026; van pickup available in Marshall and Weaverville.

candidates.name: Madison County Parks and Recreation
candidates.note: County summer recreation program posts registration forms and summer 2025 and 2026 trip information.

candidates.name: N.C. Cooperative Extension — Madison County 4-H
candidates.note: 2025 Summer Fun day programs for ages 5–18 included agriculture, science, cooking and outdoor adventure.

candidates.name: Spruce Pine Montessori School
candidates.note: Summer care offers weekly enrollment, themed activities and outdoor play, with before care from 7:30 a.m. and aftercare until 5:30 p.m.

candidates.name: Summer Funshine Day Camp
candidates.note: Free summer recreation for people with developmental disabilities, including children; a June 19, 2025 event was listed in Burnsville.
